text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! I don't wanna!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway when I
suddenly
hear a loud, defiant cry.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna do any extra classes! I can
get good
test scores even without them!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you want?! Are you gonna tell me I need extra classes just like my teacher?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't WANNA! It shouldn't even
be such a
big deal that I was late to class
'cause I was
practicing my magic!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Come back to the class
right now,
young lady!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wha?! She's coming! What should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like I said! I. Don't. Wannaaaaa!
choice_data_list: Let's go take the remedial class.
Let's make a run for it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, she's going to find me at this
rate! I need
to find a way to...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: SHHH! Be quiet! Just stand right there!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Where are you? Sweep
Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. She's gone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ You're pretty useful as a wall,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You keep what happened here a secret,
and I'll
make sure your job as a wall
stays safe, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Seems like my "wall" days aren't over
yet.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I was thinking that too! There's no way
she can
outrun me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not long before I glimpse Sweep
Tosho
through the windows, dashing
away at top speed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! That was a cinch! ♪ Let's see
her try to
catch me now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's going on here?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove! Am I glad to see you!
This young
lady is trying to weasel her
way out of attending
her supplementary
classes.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way! No, no, noooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. What a stroke of luck that you
decided
to stop here.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! I don't wanna! Let me go!
LEMME
GOOO!
